Band Name Generator

Generate original band names by genre — rock, metal, pop, hip-hop, electronic, jazz, punk or indie — with one click and copy.

Click any name to copy it. Original combinations — check trademarks before commercial use.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick your music genre.
  2. Press Generate band names.
  3. Click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the names made?

Each genre has its own curated word pools, and the generator combines them in genre-typical patterns (e.g. The + plural for rock, dark compounds for metal).

Can I use a name for my real band?

They are original random combinations from word lists — always do a trademark search before using one commercially.

Can I get more names?

Press Generate again for a fresh batch of 8 names.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
